title: run github project payload digest novel

rubric.text: Removes the superseded banner and `<details>` wrapper, normalizes CRLF and trailing newlines, and finds the predecessor's payload digest unchanged, so the presentation edit does not invalidate history.

Accepts the report as naming the exact predecessor permalink and digest, normalizes both into the ranker input with the same bare-hex digest form, and does not treat a raw-body or prefixed digest as a different plan.
